summary: Race writes now replace all known playable/vampire race RefIDs inside Player ChangeForm 400014 and Live Player ChangeForm 400007 instead of only the first pair.
notes: This reduces mixed-race/hybrid saves where showracemenu left stale old race refs beside the new race.
Header race text is patched only when the target editor ID fits the existing fixed header string slot.
The header string is not resized because shifting the ESS header can invalidate compressed payload location tables.
Appearance/head-part/FaceGen data may still require showracemenu for a completely clean visual rebuild.
